frequency_question: How often do major industry-specific financial schemes announced by industrial ministries get fully implemented within a three-year horizon?
membership_rule: Includes central government schemes with allocated budget outlays providing capital subsidies or credit guarantees for specific industrial sectors (e.g., FAME phases, PLI schemes for specific sectors); excludes general budgetary announcements without subsequent ministry guidelines.

PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major named central industrial/EV incentive initiatives; all successfully finalized and implemented by the ministry.
known_gaps: Does not account for delays past initial target dates, only whether they were eventually finalized and implemented.
skeleton: Central government industrial incentive programs initiated and finalized by the relevant line ministry over the last 10 years
multiplier: 5 hits / 5 total major industrial incentive programs = 1.00 base rate
validity_reason: The institutional framework and bureaucratic commitment to rolling out EV and manufacturing subsidies under current industrial policy remain highly stable.
